summary.text: Steven Ouellette is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 8th Bristol District since January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He graduated from Westport High School and has worked as a call firefighter, reserve police officer, town selectman, and in municipal maintenance.

paragraphs.text: Steven Ouellette graduated from Westport High School.

His career experience includes working as a call firefighter, reserve police officer, town selectman, and in municipal maintenance, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as municipal facilities director.
He has been affiliated with the United Association of Plumbers & Pipefitters Local 77.

Ouellette succeeded Paul Schmid III in the 8th Bristol District seat, and Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 assignments as the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs, the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee, and the joint committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity; Agriculture and Fisheries; and Emergency Preparedness and Management.
